verdict.rationale: Kit is an email-marketing SaaS that handles creator and subscriber data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such a policy, setting, or opt-out. The email-stats retention note and the MCP account-access docs are about other capabilities and do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
